BrowserFrame.description: Any durable browser frame: Server-owned types here, activity/run.completed/run.failed from terminal-v2 browser schema. Internal fields are forbidden on every frame and payload.

ResponseKind.description: re_explanation = 기존 풀이 재설명(검증 없이 스트리밍, Front는 '추가 설명' 표시). 부재는 이 확장 이전 응답이다.

Disclosure.description: The turn's answer-disclosure scope (Brain DisclosureScope; the same one assistantResponse was published under).

StepCheckResult.description: verified=✓, falsified=✗, unparseable=검산 안 됨, not_checked=검산 대상 아님.

SympyStatement.description: The formula the deterministic checker checked; which fields matter depends on stepKind (define: name+value, given: cond, case: cond(+covers), claim: lhs+rhs(+name), choose: value(+choice)).

CheckableStep.description: One rendered solution step: the screen shows description (SafeMarkdown without source markers, or literal text when descriptionFormat is plain_text) with its ✓·✗ mark. withheld=true (disclosure hide_answer): kind and mark only — description, descriptionFormat and sympyStatement are null. checkReason never appears.

CrossCheckSummary.description: Agreement flags only — the independent answer and its program stay internal (docs/plan/27).

SolutionCheck.description: One verified solution. Order = Read-back problems order = response order (problemNumber may be null for text input). disclosure is the turn's answer-disclosure scope: full = steps public; hide_answer = every step withheld (kind and mark only); hide_solution = no steps.

CompletionExtension.description: browser-run-fixtures-v1.1 additive fields of run.completed payload and conversation AssistantMessageContent. All three appear together or not at all (absent = response from before this extension). Badge (not_applicable solutions are left out of the count): unverified iff any solution is unverified; else verified iff any is verified; else not_applicable (all not_applicable, or none). solutionChecks order = Read-back problems order = response order.

ReadBackCompletedPayload.description: Activity Kind read_back (Phase 2 Read-back, '이렇게 읽었어요'): the activity.completed payload with problems[] of problemNumber/questionText/choices/figureDescription. Defined in terminal-v2 browser schema (generated from Brain activity.py).

ReadBackGuard.description: A read-back precedes verification: no solution, step, formula, answer or internal problem id on it.

NoInternalKeys.description: Internal run keys never appear on a public frame, payload or Server-owned response object.
